thread:
Sofia (Vendor Ops): Vendor BlockLeaf submitted invoice BL-0426 asking to be paid in BTC and unsure which tax form to provide. Attached: https://files.redwood/blockleaf/invoice-apr26.png

Ava (Finance): Payment method doesn't change tax requirements. Need to know which legal entity issued the invoice. US entity -> W-9, non-US -> W-8BEN-E. Also validate VAT ID for reverse charge. Paste invoice header?

Liam (Tax): Also confirm service vs royalty. Royalties can create withholding. For EU B2B with valid VAT, reverse charge often applies.

Sofia (Vendor Ops): Header:
```
Invoice: BL-2026-0426
Seller: BlockLeaf Ltd
Registered in: United Kingdom
Alternate billing: BlockLeaf Inc (US)
VAT: NL123456789B01
Payment: BTC wallet
Notes: Founder US-based; ops spanning NL/UK/US
```

Priya (AP): Put the invoice on hold (Hold code: TAX_DOCS_REQUESTED). Ask vendor for: 1) company registration docs for invoicing entity; 2) VAT verification (gov.uk or VIES screenshot); 3) completed W-8BEN-E or W-9; 4) confirmation of whether line is services or royalties; 5) payout legal name for crypto reconciliation. CC ap-docs@redwood on upload.

Marco (BlockLeaf): We're BlockLeaf Ltd (UK). VAT line was a leftover from NL testing. We can reissue from the UK entity. We don't have a W-9 for the UK company. We also asked our payments team about gross-up in case of US withholding  will Redwood gross-up if withholding is applied?

tax-bot: VIES check: NL123456789B01 -> INVALID (checked 2026-04-25 09:12 UTC).

Liam (Tax): If you reissue from the UK company and provide: (a) Certificate of Incorporation (UK); (b) UK VAT verification or confirmation of no VAT charged; (c) signed W-8BEN-E asserting foreign status; and (d) clear invoice description (platform/service), then we can clear the hold. Gross-up is not standard; usually not provided unless contractually agreed. For typical SaaS/platform fees, withholding risk is low.

Ava (Finance): Next steps: vendor to reissue invoice from BlockLeaf Ltd (UK) with correct VAT or blank VAT, attach incorporation docs and W-8BEN-E, and clarify invoice line. No payment until docs uploaded.

Priya (AP): Added hold note in accounting: "VIES failed; awaiting reissued invoice and tax docs." Will release hold when ap-docs@redwood receives files.

Marco (BlockLeaf): We'll reissue and upload docs today. We'll drop gross-up unless you advise otherwise. Thanks.

Liam (Tax): Sounds good. We'll review the reissued invoice. If any royalties/us-source issues appear we'll follow up. :thumbsup:

Ava (Finance): Sofia please update thread after upload."
